name: campus-maintenance-copilot
description: AI Field Inspection Copilot for campus maintenance with mobile offline capture, Gemini reporting, Express/MongoDB API, and React supervisor dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@campus/shared run build && npm --workspace=@campus/api run build && npm --workspace=@campus/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@campus/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@campus/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@campus/web run typecheck && npm --workspace=@campus/mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@campus/shared run test && npm --workspace=@campus/api run test && npm --workspace=@campus/web run test && npm --workspace=@campus/mobile run test
